title: 第23章 我一人做事一人当第24章 修炼这么快你是不是修魔功了
slug: 全宗开挂大师姐她就爱贴脸开大
lines: 林筱天仙子的任务还没完成，拒绝了蒋凤熙的帮助，也没有理会魏明几人欲言又止的神情，她转身没入了竹林深处。
蒋凤熙看魏明几人的表情就知道他们在想什么，也懒得去多言什么。
对魏明他们来说，林筱的行为都可以称得上惊世骇俗了，可她偏偏欣赏的就是林筱的这份惊世骇俗。
她热衷于一切有挑战性的事物，这会让她浑身血液都跟着沸腾。
修仙，修的就是一个狂字。
之前没人懂她，只觉得她疯癫，她也不在意他人眼光，只从心而为。
她以为她已经很狂了，没想到几年未见，她的小师姐给了她一个这么大的惊喜。
蒋凤熙想到林筱伸手拦她时身上不经意流露的气势，嘴角就扯起一抹弧度。
这次回来宗门，看来是回来对了。
“行了，别看了，我送你们回宗门。”
蒋凤熙懒散的声音叫回魏明几人的思绪，他们看看走入丛林做任务的大师姐，又看看一脸无所谓的二师姐，都不知该摆什么表情了。
不是，那可是沈知意诶，怎么大师姐，二师姐表现的像是要去挑战一个练气修士一样简单？
魏明几人苦笑一声。
他们都可以想象，等其他弟子知道这件事，天衍宗会乱成什么样。
林筱心态很平淡，在系统的勤恳扫描下，终于功夫不负有心人，她在灵竹林一个角落找到了她要找的天仙子。
这是一株散发金光的灵药，周围有一层薄雾，风一吹灵药的枝叶就摆动，从远处看就像是一个翩翩起舞的仙子，这也是它名字的由来。
林筱把天仙子用特定宝盒装起来。
“叮，恭喜宿主完成找到天仙子的任务，任务奖励已发放，请查收。”
系统悄悄冒出头，“宿主大大，你真敢挑战啊，那可是元婴修士。”
林筱方才的惊人之举把系统都逼出来了。
要是林筱到时候被沈知意打死了，它还得重新找宿主呢。
林筱把宝盒放进腰间的储物袋里，“我都不怕，你一个系统怕什么，要是不想我死，那就拿点诚意出来啊。”
系统顿了顿，“好的宿主大大，我会努力发布任务的。”
林筱动作一停。
她是要小系统给她开挂，不是让它给她发任务啊喂！
“叮，恭喜宿主勇敢的精神打动系统，系统发布特殊任务：请宿主在十年后中州大比上打赢玄天剑宗弟子沈知意。”
“成功奖励宿主等级提升一级，三品丹药九转升灵丹一枚，高级传送卷轴一个，天阶功法刹那永恒一份。”
系统任务一出，林筱瞬间眼一亮。
九转升灵丹，那可是元婴突破化神的敲门砖，有了它，等于半只脚踏入化神境界了。
高级传送卷轴不用多说，后面那个天级功法才是重头戏，真宝贝。
天级功法，那可是足以让修真界陷入疯狂的高级功法。
刹那永恒，发动时，只要不高过发动者一整个大境界，都会被强行静止十秒时间。
施法范围随着修炼者修为升高而逐渐扩大，甚至修炼到极致，心念一动，整个修真界的时间都会被瞬间暂停。
林筱舔舔唇。
果然，风险伴随着机遇。
风险越大，机遇越好。
林筱回去天衍宗，天衍宗弟子看她的眼神都异常奇怪，林筱只当没察觉，走到任务堂交任务。
任务堂的弟子接天仙子时手都在抖，话都说不利索了。
“这，这是任务奖励回元丹，大大大师姐，您拿好。”
林筱刚接过丹药，一道黑缝突然从她头顶裂开，林筱都没来得及反应，一只手从裂缝里伸出直接把她抓了进去。
她眼前一花，回神时她站在了一个大殿中，最前方是大长老，左边站着的依次是二长老，三长老，还有几个林筱不认识的，估计也是长老。
content_en:
Fairy Lin Xiaotian's mission had not yet been completed. She refused Jiang Fengxi's help and ignored the hesitant expressions of Wei Ming and others. She turned around and disappeared into the depths of the bamboo forest.
Jiang Fengxi knew what Wei Ming and others were thinking by looking at their expressions, and didn't bother to say anything more.
To Wei Ming and others, Lin Xiao's behavior could be called shocking, but what she admired was Lin Xiao's shocking behavior.
She is passionate about anything challenging that makes her blood boil.
To cultivate immortality is to cultivate the word "crazy".
No one understood her before, they just thought she was crazy. She didn't care about other people's opinions and just acted from her heart.
She thought she was already crazy, but she didn't expect that her little senior sister, whom she hadn't seen for several years, would give her such a big surprise.
Jiang Fengxi thought of Lin Xiao's inadvertent aura when he reached out to stop her, and the corner of her mouth curled up.
It seems that it is the right time to come back to the sect this time.
"Okay, stop looking, I'll take you back to the sect."
Jiang Fengxi's lazy voice called back the thoughts of Wei Ming and others. They looked at the senior sister who walked into the jungle to do the task, and then looked at the second senior sister who looked indifferent, and they didn't know what expression to put on.
No, that's Shen Zhiyi, why do the senior and second senior sisters act as if they are going to challenge a Qi-training monk?
Wei Ming and others laughed bitterly.
They can all imagine what kind of chaos the Tianyan Sect will be in when other disciples find out about this.
…
Lin Xiao's mentality was very dull. After diligent scanning by the system, her hard work finally paid off. She found the fairy she was looking for in a corner of the Lingzhu Forest.
This is an elixir that emits golden light, surrounded by a layer of mist. The branches and leaves of the elixir sway when the wind blows. From a distance, it looks like a dancing fairy, which is also the origin of its name.
Lin Xiao packed Tian Xianzi in a specific treasure box.
"Ding, congratulations to the host for completing the task of finding the Heavenly Fairy. The task reward has been distributed, please check it."
The system quietly popped up, "Host, you really dare to challenge me, that's the Nascent Soul cultivator."
Lin Xiao's amazing move just now forced the system out.
If Lin Xiao is beaten to death by Shen Zhiyi, he will have to find another host.
Lin Xiao put the treasure box into the storage bag on his waist, "I'm not afraid. What are you afraid of from a system? If you don't want me to die, then show some sincerity."
"Well..."
The system paused, "Okay host, I will try my best to release the task."
Lin Xiao stopped moving.
She wants the little system to cheat her, not to let it send her tasks!
"Ding, congratulations to the host for impressing the system with his brave spirit. The system has issued a special task: asking the host to defeat Xuantian Sword Sect disciple Shen Zhiyi in the Zhongzhou Competition ten years later."
"Successful rewards will increase the host's level by one level, a third-grade elixir and a ninth-level upgrade elixir, an advanced teleportation scroll, and a copy of the heaven-level technique Instant Eternity."
As soon as the system task came out, Lin Xiao's eyes lit up instantly.
The Nine Transformation Spiritual Pill is the stepping stone for Yuanying to break through to become a god. With it, it is like having half a foot in the realm of becoming a god.
Needless to say about the advanced teleportation scroll, the heaven-level technique at the back is the highlight, it’s a real treasure.
Heaven-level skills are advanced skills that are enough to drive the world of cultivation into madness.
When the moment of eternity is activated, as long as it is not a whole realm higher than the initiator, it will be forcibly stopped for ten seconds.
The range of spellcasting gradually expands as the cultivator's cultivation level increases, and even when the cultivator reaches the extreme level, the time of the entire cultivation world will be suspended instantly with a thought.
Lin Xiao licked her lips.
Sure enough, risks come with opportunities.
The greater the risk, the greater the opportunity.
When Lin Xiao returned to Tianyan Sect, the disciples of Tianyan Sect looked at her very strangely. Lin Xiao just pretended not to notice and walked to the task hall to hand in the task.
When the disciples of the mission hall received Fairy Tian, ​​their hands were shaking and they were having trouble speaking.
"Here, this is the mission reward, Yuan Dan. Senior Sister, please take it."
As soon as Lin Xiao took the elixir, a black crack suddenly opened above her head. Before Lin Xiao had time to react, a hand stretched out from the crack and grabbed her directly.
Her eyes blurred, and when she came to her senses, she was standing in a large hall. The first elder was at the front, and on the left were the second elder, the third elder, and a few others whom Lin Xiao didn't recognize, who were probably also elders.
